title_en: UN peacekeeping chief warns of ‘security vacuum’ as Blue Helmets leave Lebanon and Western Sahara
title_zh: 联合国维和部队负责人警告称，蓝盔部队撤离黎巴嫩和西撒哈拉将出现“安全真空”

paragraphs.en: The UN’s peacekeeping chief warned on Wednesday that the withdrawal of “Blue Helmets” from Lebanon and Western Sahara risks leaving a dangerous security vacuum, while the Security Council remains divided over what, if anything, should replace them.
paragraphs.zh: 联合国维和事务负责人周三警告说，随着“蓝盔”部队撤出黎巴嫩和西撒哈拉，可能会留下危险的安全真空，而安理会对于是否应有、以及应有何种力量取而代之仍存在分歧。

paragraphs.en: The UN mission in Western Sahara closed on 31 October after 35 years. In Lebanon, the peacekeeping force that has patrolled the border with Israel since 1978 is due to cease operations at the end of the year.
paragraphs.zh: 联合国西撒哈拉特派团在运作35年后于10月31日关闭。在黎巴嫩，自1978年以来一直在黎以边境巡逻的维和部队定于今年年底停止行动。

paragraphs.en: Briefing journalists at UN Headquarters in New York, Mr. Lacroix said the organization was losing some of its longest-standing military deployments, with no guarantee that the countries concerned could maintain stability on their own.
paragraphs.zh: 拉克鲁瓦（Lacroix）先生在纽约联合国总部向记者通报情况时说，联合国正在失去一些历史最悠久的军事部署，而相关国家能否自行维持稳定并无保障。

paragraphs.en: Around 7,500 peacekeepers are still serving with the UN Interim Force in Lebanon ( UNIFIL ). The force acts as a go-between for the Lebanese and Israeli armies, monitors violations and helps humanitarian aid get through.
paragraphs.zh: 目前仍有约7500名维和人员在联合国驻黎巴嫩临时部队（UNIFIL，简称联黎部队）服役。该部队充当黎巴嫩军队与以色列军队之间的中间人，监督违反停火行为，并协助人道主义援助通行。

paragraphs.en: Mr. Lacroix has just returned from Lebanon. He said President Joseph Aoun and Prime Minister Nawaf Salam had told him they feared a “security vacuum” once the peacekeepers leave, with no one left to stop border incidents from turning into clashes.
paragraphs.zh: 拉克鲁瓦先生刚刚从黎巴嫩返回。他说，约瑟夫·奥恩（Joseph Aoun）总统和纳瓦夫·萨拉姆（Nawaf Salam）总理告诉他，他们担心维和人员撤离后会出现“安全真空”，届时将无人阻止边境事件演变为冲突。

paragraphs.en: There is a humanitarian cost too. Mr. Lacroix offered a cautious estimate that about 10,000 people are still living between the Blue Line and the forward defence line Israel has set up inside Lebanese territory. Their access to aid depends heavily on UNIFIL.
paragraphs.zh: 人道主义方面也有代价。拉克鲁瓦先生谨慎估计，目前约有1万人在“蓝线”与以色列在黎巴嫩境内设立的前沿防线之间生活。他们能否获得援助在很大程度上取决于联黎部队。

paragraphs.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres put forward options in June, but the Security Council has yet to agree on any follow-on arrangement. Mr. Lacroix urged council members to decide what form a future international presence could take.
paragraphs.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯（António Guterres）6月提出了几种方案，但安理会尚未就任何后续安排达成一致。拉克鲁瓦先生敦促安理会成员就未来国际存在的形式作出决定。

paragraphs.en: The same deadlock has already ended the UN’s presence in Western Sahara. The UN Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (MINURSO) shut down on 31 October after council members failed to agree on renewing its mandate.
paragraphs.zh: 同样的僵局已经导致联合国在西撒哈拉的存在终结。联合国西撒哈拉全民投票特派团（MINURSO，简称西撒特派团）在安理会成员未能就延长其任期达成一致后，于10月31日关闭。

paragraphs.en: Russia vetoed a United States draft that would have reshaped the mission around a solution based on autonomy under Moroccan sovereignty. A rival Russian text calling for a one-year renewal fell short of the nine votes needed to pass.
paragraphs.zh: 俄罗斯否决了美国提出的一项草案，该草案原本将围绕在摩洛哥主权下实行自治的解决方案重塑该特派团。俄罗斯提出的另一份要求延长一年的草案未能获得通过所需的九票。

paragraphs.en: MINURSO was set up in 1991 to monitor a ceasefire between Morocco and the Polisario Front. It never held the self-determination referendum it was created to organize, and hostilities in the territory resumed in 2020.
paragraphs.zh: 西撒特派团成立于1991年，负责监督摩洛哥与波利萨里奥阵线（Polisario Front）之间的停火。它始终未能举行其设立初衷所要求组织的自决全民投票，而该地区的敌对行动于2020年重启。
